newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Fafer exceeds limit-up on Brussels bourse.
newsitem.headline: Fafer exceeds limit-up on Brussels bourse.

text.p: Shares in Belgian stainless steel maker Fabrique de Fer de Charleroi exceeded the upper limit for movement on the Brussels Stock Exchange on Friday as a report the company was to be sold sent bid/ask prices soaring.
Fafer is quoted on the bourse's cash market, where prices are fixed twice daily. Prices are allowed to move by no more than five percent in any one direction at each fixing.

Fafer bid/ask was indicated at 200,000 francs following the report in newspaper Le Soir, 83 percent above Thursday's closing price of 109,000 francs. If no shares are traded today, the bourse will fix an indicative price for them.
